proof_body:
by
  intro r s a b
  have hmul : ∀ (r s a b : ℝ), ((r : ℂ) * ((Real.cos a : ℂ) + (Real.sin a : ℂ) * Complex.I)) * ((s : ℂ) * ((Real.cos b : ℂ) + (Real.sin b : ℂ) * Complex.I)) = ((r * s : ℝ) : ℂ) * ((Real.cos (a + b) : ℂ) + (Real.sin (a + b) : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
    intro r s a b
    rw [Real.cos_add, Real.sin_add]
    simp only [Complex.ofReal_add, Complex.ofReal_sub, Complex.ofReal_mul]
    linear_combination ((r : ℂ) * s * Real.sin a * Real.sin b) * Complex.I_sq
  refine ⟨hmul r s a b, fun hs => ?_⟩
  have hne : (s : ℂ) * ((Real.cos b : ℂ) + (Real.sin b : ℂ) * Complex.I) ≠ 0 := by
    apply mul_ne_zero (by exact_mod_cast hs)
    intro h
    have := congrArg norm h
    rw [Complex.norm_add_mul_I, show Real.cos b ^ 2 + Real.sin b ^ 2 = 1 by linarith [Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq b], Real.sqrt_one, norm_zero] at this
    norm_num at this
  rw [div_eq_iff hne, mul_comm ((r / s : ℝ) : ℂ), mul_assoc]
  have := hmul (r / s) s (a - b) b
  rw [sub_add_cancel, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hs] at this
  rw [← this]
  ring
target_source: ∀ (r s a b : ℝ), ((r : ℂ) * ((Real.cos a : ℂ) + (Real.sin a : ℂ) * Complex.I)) * ((s : ℂ) * ((Real.cos b : ℂ) + (Real.sin b : ℂ) * Complex.I)) = ((r * s : ℝ) : ℂ) * ((Real.cos (a + b) : ℂ) + (Real.sin (a + b) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ∧ (s ≠ 0 → ((r : ℂ) * ((Real.cos a : ℂ) + (Real.sin a : ℂ) * Complex.I)) / ((s : ℂ) * ((Real.cos b : ℂ) + (Real.sin b : ℂ) * Complex.I)) = ((r / s : ℝ) : ℂ) * ((Real.cos (a - b) : ℂ) + (Real.sin (a - b) : ℂ) * Complex.I))
